_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "The row" is the status-bar hook's row, [data-testid="status-bar-hook"]. "Go within the app to URL" means: eval (() => { window.history.pushState({}, '', 'URL'); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); })(), without reloading. "Send" means: fill the message input (data-testid "message-input") with "Hello", then click the send button (data-testid "send-button"). For CSS checks, eval getComputedStyle on the element and compare the property exactly. On a phone, swipes on the status row leave the conversation drawer alone, even when the row's content fits. window.swipe(selector, startX, endX) dispatches a synthetic horizontal swipe on the first element matching selector and returns whether it was taken (its touchmove's default prevented), "true" or "false"; it runs once per eval, so use evals without expect, or with expect only when a single run's result is the check. "The drawer" is ".drawer"; it is open when it has the class "open". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/swipe. 2. A link inside the row should be visible. 3. The row's content fits: eval (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="status-bar-hook"]'); return el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth; })() with expect "true". 4. The drawer must not have the class "open" (eval with expect "false" of document.querySelector('.drawer').classList.contains('open')). 5. Eval window.swipe('[data-testid="status-bar-hook"]', 180, 256) with expect "false"; the drawer must still not be open. 6. Eval window.swipe('.status-hook-row .text-link', 180, 256) with expect "false"; the drawer must still not be open. 7. Call "status long" (the row's text becomes long), then reload the page. 8. The row should contain "long-status-". 9. It overflows: eval (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="status-bar-hook"]'); return el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth; })() with expect "true". 10. Eval window.swipe('.status-hook-row .status-hook-item', 180, 256) with expect "false"; the drawer must still not be open. 11. Eval window.swipe('.main-content', 180, 256) with expect "true"; the drawer should come to have the class "open". 12. Eval window.swipe('.backdrop', 350, 150) with expect "true"; the drawer should come to not have the class "open".
